== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Stormtrooper Backpack with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160807035552/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/stormtrooperbackpack.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Stormtrooper Backpack (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/22/Premiere-D-stormtrooperbackpack-PC-Errata-disc.gif Internet Archive item].
